# cloudxino_reserved_ip (Resource)

A reserved IP: a public IPv4 address the team keeps until it is destroyed, pointed at a CC2 server in the same region. Moving it to another server keeps the address. Billed per hour while it exists, assigned or not.

Point it at a server either with `server_id` here or with a `cloudxino_reserved_ip_assignment` (so the address outlives a server that is replaced), not both.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# A reserved IP pointed at a server. Changing server_id moves the address; removing it unassigns it.
resource "cloudxino_reserved_ip" "web" {
  region    = cloudxino_server.web.region # the server must be in the same region
  server_id = cloudxino_server.web.id
}

output "web_address" {
  value = cloudxino_reserved_ip.web.ip_address
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `project_id` (String) Left out = the team's default project.
- `region` (String) Region ID; left out = the default region. A server it points at must be in this region. Changing it replaces the reserved IP (a new address).
- `server_id` (String) ID of a `cloudxino_server` in the same region to point the address at. Changing it moves the address; removing it unassigns it. Leave it out when a `cloudxino_reserved_ip_assignment` manages the assignment.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `ip_address` (String) The address.
- `status` (String) `available` (not pointing anywhere), `assigned` or `deleting`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
terraform import cloudxino_reserved_ip.web <reserved_ip_id>
```
